services.name: Hobie Kayak
services.desc: The Hobie MirageDrive is a pedal powered propulsion system. It replaces the kayak paddle with two underwater fins driven by the rider's legs. Instead of pulling a blade through the water with your arms, you push a pair of pedals. The fins then sweep back and forth beneath the hull to produce thrust.Hobie introduced the MirageDrive in 1997, and it remains the defining feature of the brand's pedal kayak line. This page explains how the system works, how the three current drive versions differ, and how to choose between them.
